title: EAC self-integrity in 2020: a live driver and its pool copy
summary: The original CVEAC-2020 writeup supports a narrow reconstruction of nonpaged section comparison and the researcher’s response. The article label is not a registered CVE and none of the results independently establish current exploitability.
author: Observatory editorial
takeaways: The reconstructed memcmp checks selected sections against a private copy rather than hashing an entire driver.
The researcher reports an observed kick and debugger tracing; this catalog did not repeat either.
CVEAC-2020 is the researcher’s project/article label, not a CVE identifier, and no modern-version claim follows.
